6| # Qwen OCR Skill

13| - User asks to extract content from an image.

20| ## Boundaries
21| 
22| - Do not use `pdftotext`, `tesseract`, OCRmyPDF, or `pip install`.
23| - Do not guess image content from the path.
24| - Do not print API keys.
25| - PDF tasks must still start from this skill. For local PDFs, use the controlled PDF-to-image + Qwen OCR script. Do not use random local OCR tools.

34|   - `scripts/qwen_ocr.py` for images.
35|   - `scripts/qwen_ocr_pdf.py` for PDFs.
36|   - `scripts/qwen_ocr_openai.mjs` only when Node OpenAI SDK is available.

38| Official request shape:
39| - `model: qwen3.5-ocr`
40| - `messages[0].content[0].type: image_url`
41| - `messages[0].content[0].image_url.url: remote URL or local data URL`

87| - `--preprocess none`: best for normal pages and highest text fidelity.
88| - `--preprocess watermark`: force suppresses pale repeated background watermarks before OCR, but may lose faint form text. Use only for visibly watermark-dominated pages, not whole documents by default.
